answer.reason: The verses tell of Lachish's capture by Joshua, the death of Amaziah there, and Sennacherib's siege, each an event that belongs to the place.

clauses.english: was taken by Israel on the second day and put to the sword
clauses.quote: the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel

clauses.english: was where Amaziah fled from the conspirators and was slain
was besieged by Sennacherib king of Assyria
clauses.quote: he himself laid siege against Lachish
